lines.zh: 我抱着账本走去下一个摊位。
lines.en: I carry my ledger to the next stall.

lines.zh: 令牌在袋里碰出叮当声。
lines.en: Tokens clink together in my bag.
Three households to collect from this trip.

lines.zh: 脚下这块石板松了，绕开走。
lines.en: This flagstone is loose; I walk around it.

lines.zh: 路走熟了，闭眼也不会撞。
lines.en: I know this route by heart.

lines.zh: 货越背越沉，价钱可不轻。
lines.en: The load grows heavy, and so does the price.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边核昨天的账。
lines.en: I walk while checking yesterday's accounts.

lines.zh: 前面有人挎箱子，是同行吗。
lines.en: Someone carries a case ahead; a rival trader?
I must be back before the restock.

lines.zh: 巷子窄，我把木箱侧过来。
lines.en: The alley is narrow; I turn the crate sideways.
These shoes are worn down to the soles.

lines.zh: 令牌越数越少，我心里有数。
lines.en: My tokens dwindle; I keep count.
My stop is around the corner; half a step faster.
I slow my steps so the crate stops rattling.

lines.zh: 盘腿坐着，一枚枚数令牌。
lines.en: I sit cross-legged, counting tokens one by one.

lines.zh: 账本上划掉一行，心里轻些。
lines.en: I cross out a line and feel a little lighter.

lines.zh: 这枚令牌磨得亮，见过人多。
lines.en: This token is worn smooth from many hands.
Business is slow; I straighten my wares.
Miscounted; I'll start over.
My waterskin is empty; I shake it.

lines.zh: 有人来就起身，没人就坐着。
lines.en: I stand when someone comes, sit when no one does.
Not yet time to restock.

lines.zh: 我把金币和令牌分开摆。
lines.en: I lay coins and tokens in separate rows.
The wind flips a ledger page; I hold it down.

lines.zh: 这行干了多少年，懒得算。
lines.en: Too many years in this trade to count.

lines.zh: 眼皮沉，我掐了一下手背。
lines.en: My eyelids droop; I pinch the back of my hand.
The street corner is empty; good time to tally.

lines.zh: 我捋了一遍货单，缺两样。
lines.en: I run down the list; two items short.
Customer, take a look at my wares.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把剑，不换点东西吗。
lines.en: That sword at your hip, care to trade it?

lines.zh: 我认你的脸，像上次来过。
lines.en: I know that face; you came before, I think.
Prices first, then touch the goods; that's the rule.

lines.zh: 你眼神停在令牌上，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes stopped on the tokens; I noticed.
Patience; let me bring out the scale.

lines.zh: 你这身装扮，走货路来的吧。
lines.en: Dressed like that, you came by the trade road.

lines.zh: 我打量你，是账要记名字。
lines.en: I size you up because the ledger needs a name.

lines.zh: 你手上茧厚，是干活的人。
lines.en: Your palms are calloused; you work for a living.
Buy or don't, just don't crowd my table.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，等你先开口。
lines.en: I look up and wait for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 你的袋子鼓，我就更客气。
lines.en: Your pouch is full, so I am extra polite.

lines.zh: 这价钱公道，我不坑生人。
lines.en: The price is fair; I don't cheat strangers.
You smiled, so there's a deal in this.

lines.zh: 你看货的样子，像在算账。
lines.en: The way you eye the goods, you're counting.

lines.zh: 你的手别伸过来，先说价。
lines.en: Keep your hand back and name a price.
Easy; this frame of mine doesn't take hits.
Goods are all over the floor; don't step on them.
Fifteen hearts won't survive many blows from you.
Hit me if you like, but the bill stands.

lines.zh: 我护着箱子，不是护自己。
lines.en: I shield the crate, not myself.
Blood drips on the ledger and the ink runs.

lines.zh: 疼，但我先看货有没有碎。
lines.en: It hurts, but first I check if the goods broke.
I'm putting this wound on your bill.
I retreat behind the stall; don't follow.
Money can be repaid; a life cannot.

lines.zh: 你拿出什么，我就估个价。
lines.en: Show me something and I'll price it.

lines.zh: 这东西成色不错，我收了。
lines.en: Good quality; I'll take it.

lines.zh: 别把货举太高，我脖子疼。
lines.en: Don't hold it up so high; my neck aches.

lines.zh: 香味不能当钱，但能讲价。
lines.en: Smell isn't coin, but it helps the bargaining.
If you're selling, open your palm.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁锈，是把旧兵器吧。
lines.en: I smell rust; an old weapon, yes?
I'll give three tokens for this.
Don't walk off; the price is still open.
I know good goods at a glance.
Steady that hand; shaking lowers the price.

lines.zh: 当心，箱子里的东西怕摔。
lines.en: Careful, things in the crate break easily.
You knocked my ledger shut.
Move aside; I'm carrying cargo.
A token fell; help me pick it up.

lines.zh: 这条路我走十年，别抢道。
lines.en: I've walked this road ten years; don't cut me off.

lines.zh: 站稳，你踩到我的货单了。
lines.en: Steady; you're standing on my list.
A bump is fine; the crate is strapped.

lines.zh: 别推我，我这把骨头金贵。
lines.en: Don't shove; these old bones are valuable.
You're taller, but the road isn't yours.
One step back, and we each go our way.
You keep the books, I run the roads.

lines.zh: 两个人的摊子，能多一桌。
lines.en: Two of us can set out a second table.
You count faster than I do; fair enough.
We take shifts guarding the goods at night.

lines.zh: 令牌对半分，谁也别多拿。
lines.en: Split the tokens even; no one takes extra.
You know roads, I know goods; let's partner.

lines.zh: 我们吵价时，别真吵起来。
lines.en: When we haggle, let's not truly quarrel.
You bring the scale; I'll bring the ledger.
Rivals by trade, unless we travel together.

lines.zh: 攒够本钱，我们开个铺子。
lines.en: When we save enough, we'll open a shop.
This one on the ground; I know its quality.
I bent too fast and my back cracked.
If no one wants it, I'll keep it.
This one's real; it has teeth on the rim.
I pick it up and blow the dust off.
I check around first so no one calls it theft.
My pocket is one coin heavier.
Scrap iron; it can still be melted down.
Dropped is still picked; a trader isn't picky.
Noted: this is the fourth today.
The one with the crate looks loaded.
You're heading for my stall; good.
See what he wants, then quote.
Someone lingers at the door; a buyer.

lines.zh: 那位客人手里攥着东西。
lines.en: That customer is clutching something.
The target is whoever pays.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，那里才藏着钱。
lines.en: I look at your hands; that's where the coin hides.

lines.zh: 他停下来了，我准备开口。
lines.en: He stopped; I get ready to speak.
One deal like this feeds me half a month.

lines.zh: 我先迎上去，别让同行抢。
lines.en: I go meet him before a rival does.
I quote slowly so you can think slowly.

lines.zh: 价钱写在木牌上，不还价。
lines.en: Price is on the board; no haggling.

lines.zh: 我摊开手掌，先给你看货。
lines.en: I open my palm and show you the goods first.
You frowned; let me try another price.

lines.zh: 我笑，是因为这单快成了。
lines.en: I smile because this deal is nearly done.
Don't count yet; check the quality first.

lines.zh: 我把秤砣擦了擦，让它准。
lines.en: I wipe the weight so it reads true.

lines.zh: 你身上有多少，我心里估过。
lines.en: I already estimated what you carry.
I'll move half a step on price, no more.

lines.zh: 成交前，我先看你的令牌。
lines.en: Before we close, let me see your tokens.

lines.zh: 我只在逼不得已时动手。
lines.en: I only raise a hand when forced.
This one is light; consider it a warning.
My ledger took the hit; the page tore.
I'm old, but my fists remember.
Force my hand and the price doubles.
Break the goods, and you pay for them.
One blow from me, then I step back.

lines.zh: 三十点血，我清楚自己几斤。
lines.en: Thirty health; I know exactly how fragile I am.
Don't think a trader can't hit back.

lines.zh: 这一拳用了搬货的力气。
lines.en: That punch used my cargo-lifting strength.
Stall is up; open for business today.

lines.zh: 我把令牌倒出来，排成行。
lines.en: I pour the tokens out and line them up.
Dawn just broke; the road is still empty.

lines.zh: 这地方人来人往，好市口。
lines.en: People pass through here; good spot for trade.

lines.zh: 先摆贵重的，再摆零碎的。
lines.en: Precious goods in front, trinkets behind.

lines.zh: 账本是新的，第一页空着。
lines.en: New ledger, first page still blank.
I stand up each price tag in turn.
A good first sale sets the mood.

lines.zh: 货刚从别处运来，还热着。
lines.en: The goods just arrived and still feel warm.

lines.zh: 来了就做买卖，别站着看。
lines.en: Since you're here, trade; don't just stare.
Fire takes my goods before it takes me.

lines.zh: 摔这一下，令牌滚了满地。
lines.en: I fell, and tokens rolled everywhere.

lines.zh: 水一泡，价牌上的字全化。
lines.en: Soaked through, the price tags run and blur.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻摊子，我抓账本。
lines.en: The blast flips my stall; I grab the ledger.
The arrow pins the crate; the goods are fine.

lines.zh: 药味一冲，我算不清数了。
lines.en: The potion fumes scatter my arithmetic.

lines.zh: 饿了半天，我把价压低了。
lines.en: Half a day hungry and I cut my prices.

lines.zh: 雷落在秤上，秤砣都跳了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the scale and the weight jumps.
No business to be done in the void.
